operatorApproval.notes: Found while landing X01/X02: the detector still only ran when a human ran the bench script - grep showed zero runtime callers, which is exactly the gap V06's integrity audit left open. WorkerActivityAdapter now evaluates every action it records against an operator-declared DriftWatch (permitted scope plus artifact contract) when PI_TASK_DRIFT_SIGNALS is affirmatively set: 1/true/yes/on switch it on, absent, empty, 0, false or a typo such as "ture" leave it off, so the default stays off as the resilience spec demands. Signals go to a bounded deduplicated log and to an onDrift sink; a throwing sink or malformed action never breaks the observed session, and no signal changes the run. The target path is read through fingerprint.ts TARGET_ARGUMENT_KEYS (now exported) rather than duplicating a path-key list. Tests drive the real session event bus, so scope drift, contract drift and task expansion are all exercised on the live path. | CHAIN: this record supersedes X03/out-corrected (kept immutable), whose nextBaseSha named the pre-amend evidence commit; the child is cut from a6e500f6b1cc, the evidence commit as it stands now.
